title: 重结晶与升华
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/171_重结晶与升华.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/171_重结晶与升华/src.py

points.S1: 升华在通风柜，防烫不离人

shots.scene: 欣欣捧着一烧杯闪亮的晶体
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a beaker with shiny needle-like crystals at the bottom, standing beside a fume hood, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第九课：重结晶与升华。

shots.scene: 阿杰把一大瓶乙醇倒进粗品，在明火上猛煮
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pours a large amount of alcohol onto a crude solid in a flask and heats it over a gas burner flame on an open bench, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰倒了一大瓶乙醇，还用明火煮。

shots.scene: 他戴薄手套直接抓热烧杯，俯身凑近看
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand in a thin glove grabbing a steaming hot beaker and a face leaning over it, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 又戴薄手套抓热杯，脸凑上去看。

shots.scene: 冰浴里什么也没析出，小研摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks at a clear solution in an ice bath with no crystals and shakes her head at the young male student.
shots.narration: 小研：溶剂太多，晶体出不来了。

shots.scene: 反应得到的固体，杂质夹在里面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnified solid particle with impurity dots trapped inside the crystal lattice, a precipitate falling quickly from solution. No text.
shots.narration: 沉淀析出得快，会把杂质夹进去。

shots.scene: 重结晶专门纯化晶体固体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a crude off-white powder turning into clean white crystals through an arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 晶体固体的纯化，常用重结晶。

shots.scene: 产物和杂质溶解度不同
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two molecule types with different solubility bars, product and impurity side by side. No text.
shots.narration: 产物和杂质，溶解度不一样。

shots.scene: 热时溶，冷时析出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a solubility curve rising with temperature, a hot clear solution turning into crystals on cooling. No text.
shots.narration: 多数固体越热溶得越多，冷了析出。

shots.scene: 杂质留在母液里
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: crystals growing at the bottom while impurity dots stay dissolved in the liquid above. No text.
shots.narration: 产物结晶，杂质留在溶液里。

shots.scene: 五步流程
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flow of five icons, choose solvent, dissolve hot, decolorize and hot filter, cool to crystallize, filter wash and dry. No text.
shots.narration: 选溶剂、热溶、热滤、冷却、滤干。

shots.scene: 器材：烧杯烧瓶、加热搅拌器、抽滤装置
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: beakers and flasks, a stirring hot plate, a glass rod, a powder funnel, a watch glass, a dropper and a vacuum filtration setup laid out. No text.
shots.narration: 烧瓶、加热搅拌器、漏斗、抽滤装置。

shots.scene: 选对溶剂最关键
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a key icon over several solvent bottles, one bottle highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 选对溶剂，是最关键的一步。

shots.scene: 产物冷时少溶、热时多溶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: product icon barely dissolving in a cold tube and fully dissolving in a hot tube, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 理想溶剂：室温不溶，热时溶解。

shots.scene: 杂质冷热都溶或都不溶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: impurity icons either dissolved in both hot and cold tubes, or undissolved in both, two check marks. No text.
shots.narration: 杂质最好冷热都溶，或都不溶。

shots.scene: 先查溶解度数据
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reference book and a data table icon with solubility bars at hot and cold temperatures. No text.
shots.narration: 先查文献溶解度，缩小范围。

shots.scene: 用纯水不用自来水
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pure water bottle checked and a tap crossed out beside a recrystallization flask. No text.
shots.narration: 用水作溶剂，用纯水不用自来水。

shots.scene: 【实拍】几支小试管各放少量样品加溶剂
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a small spatula tip of white powder put into each of four small test tubes in a rack, then a little solvent added to each and swirled.
shots.narration: 几支小试管，少量样品加少量溶剂。

shots.scene: 室温就溶的不合适
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: tubes at room temperature, two fully dissolved with crosses, two still cloudy with question marks. No text.
shots.narration: 室温就溶了，这种溶剂不合适。

shots.scene: 【实拍】没溶的夹好放进热水浴
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a test tube clamp holds a tube with undissolved solid into a beaker of hot water, the solid dissolving.
shots.narration: 没溶的夹好放热水浴，再看溶不溶。

shots.scene: 热溶冷不溶的就选它
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one tube clear when hot and cloudy when cold with a check mark, a tube that never dissolves crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 热时溶、冷时不溶，就选它。

shots.scene: 有机溶剂易燃，不用明火
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flask of organic solvent over a gas burner flame crossed out, a warm water bath on an electric hot plate checked. No text.
shots.narration: 有机溶剂易燃，绝不能用明火。

shots.scene: 在通风柜里，柜门拉低
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the water bath and flasks inside a fume hood with the sash lowered to the marked height. No text.
shots.narration: 在通风柜里做，柜门按规定拉低。

shots.scene: 热水浴：半盆水、沸石、旋钮慢开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wide dish half filled with water on a hot plate, a few boiling chips added, the dial turned to the middle first. No text.
shots.narration: 水浴装半盆水，放沸石，旋钮慢调。

shots.scene: 先看安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a safety data sheet icon beside a chemical bottle with hazard pictograms, a magnifier. No text.
shots.narration: 动手前，先查化学品安全说明书。

shots.scene: 称粉末动作轻，防扬尘
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spatula gently transferring powder on a balance, a dust cloud crossed out, the bottle capped. No text.
shots.narration: 称粉末动作轻，用完清理盖紧。

shots.scene: 保持距离平视，戴护目镜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student in safety goggles and lab coat observing a hot flask from a distance at eye level, a face over the flask crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别把脸凑到热溶液上，戴护目镜。

shots.scene: 热烧杯用烧杯夹或隔热手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: beaker tongs and a heat resistant glove lifting a hot beaker, a thin disposable glove crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 拿热瓶用夹子或隔热手套。

shots.scene: 水浴里预热一瓶溶剂，夹牢
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flask of solvent with boiling chips clamped upright in the warm water bath. No text.
shots.narration: 水浴里预热溶剂，加沸石，夹牢。

shots.scene: 粗品放进干净干燥的烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the weighed crude solid placed into a clean dry flask. No text.
shots.narration: 称好粗品，放进干净干燥的瓶里。

shots.scene: 先留一小粒晶种
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tiny crystal set aside on a watch glass before solvent is added. No text.
shots.narration: 加溶剂前，先留一小粒当晶种。

shots.scene: 热溶剂少量多次加入
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dropper adding small portions of hot solvent to the crude solid, swirling and warming between each addition. No text.
shots.narration: 热溶剂少量多次加，摇一摇热一热。

shots.scene: 刚好溶完就停
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the last solid just dissolving and a stop icon over the solvent bottle. No text.
shots.narration: 样品刚好溶完就停。

shots.scene: 加多了析出少
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two flasks after cooling, one with little solvent and many crystals checked, one with a lot of solvent and few crystals crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 溶剂越少，最后得到的晶体越多。

shots.scene: 总有一点不溶，多半是杂质
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a few insoluble specks remaining in a clear hot solution, an arrow to filter instead of adding more solvent. No text.
shots.narration: 总有点溶不掉，多半是杂质。

shots.scene: 溶完取出搅拌子和玻璃棒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnetic retriever lifting the stir bar out and the glass rod removed. No text.
shots.narration: 溶完后，取出搅拌子和玻璃棒。

shots.scene: 该白色却发黄：有色杂质
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a yellowish hot solution where a white product is expected, an impurity color icon. No text.
shots.narration: 该是白色却发黄，有有色杂质。

shots.scene: 先离开热源稍冷，再加活性炭
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the flask lifted from the bath to cool slightly below boiling, then a small pinch of activated carbon added. No text.
shots.narration: 先稍冷到沸点以下，再加活性炭。

shots.scene: 沸腾时加炭冒泡溢出，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: carbon powder dropped into a boiling solution, violent foaming over the rim, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 沸腾时加炭，会猛烈冒泡溢出。

shots.scene: 只加一小撮，煮两三分钟
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tiny pinch of carbon, a short clock icon, a large heap of carbon crossed out because it absorbs the product. No text.
shots.narration: 只加一小撮，多了连产物都吸走。

shots.scene: 加少量助滤剂便于滤掉炭粉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a little filter aid powder added to the slightly cooled solution, the fine carbon clumping onto it. No text.
shots.narration: 炭粉太细，加点助滤剂再热滤。

shots.scene: 有不溶物立刻趁热过滤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hot solution with insoluble particles poured through a filter right away, crystals forming in a cold funnel crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 有不溶物，趁热马上滤掉。

shots.scene: 用折叠滤纸重力过滤，不抽滤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a short stem funnel with fluted filter paper over a flask, a vacuum filtration setup crossed out because it cools the solution. No text.
shots.narration: 用折叠滤纸常压热滤，不用抽滤。

shots.scene: 过滤前补点溶剂，热溶剂润湿滤纸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a little extra hot solvent added before filtering, the fluted paper wetted with hot solvent. No text.
shots.narration: 滤前多加一点溶剂，先润湿滤纸。

shots.scene: 【实拍】用烧瓶夹拿热瓶倒入
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a flask clamp holding a warm flask of water pouring slowly into a fluted filter paper in a funnel on a receiving flask.
shots.narration: 用夹子拿热瓶，慢慢倒进漏斗。

shots.scene: 原瓶荡洗，冲洗滤纸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the original flask rinsed with a little hot solvent two or three times, then the filter paper rinsed. No text.
shots.narration: 原瓶荡洗两三次，再冲冲滤纸。

shots.scene: 煮掉多余溶剂，刚好溶解
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the filtrate gently boiled in the hood until a little solid appears, then a few drops of hot solvent added until clear. No text.
shots.narration: 再煮掉多余溶剂，补点刚好溶清。

shots.scene: 盖住瓶口，室温静置
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the flask covered with a watch glass resting still on a cork ring at room temperature. No text.
shots.narration: 盖住瓶口，室温下静置冷却。

shots.scene: 不摇不碰，晶体慢慢长
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: large well-formed crystals growing slowly over a clock icon, a shaking hand crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不摇不碰，冷得慢晶体长得好。

shots.scene: 放进垫纸巾的烧杯冷得更慢
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the flask set inside a larger beaker padded with paper towels to slow cooling. No text.
shots.narration: 放进垫纸巾的大烧杯，冷得更慢。

shots.scene: 【实拍】玻璃棒轻刮瓶壁
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a glass rod gently scratching the inner wall of a flask just below the liquid surface.
shots.narration: 不析晶？玻璃棒轻刮瓶壁。

shots.scene: 别太用力，刮破烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rod scraping too hard and a crack appearing in the flask, crossed out, a cracked flask kept away from heating and ice. No text.
shots.narration: 别太用力，刮裂的瓶不能再用。

shots.scene: 投入晶种
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the saved seed crystal dropped into the cooled solution, molecules lining up around it. No text.
shots.narration: 还不行，投入留好的晶种。

shots.scene: 忘留晶种：玻璃棒蘸液晾干
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass rod dipped in the solution, air dried to form tiny crystals on its tip, then dipped back. No text.
shots.narration: 忘了留：玻璃棒蘸液晾干再引晶。

shots.scene: 降到室温后放进冰浴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the flask with crystals placed into an ice water bath. No text.
shots.narration: 析晶到室温，再放进冰浴。

shots.scene: 冰浴一段时间，析出完全
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clock icon over the ice bath, more crystals forming while impurity dots stay in the liquid. No text.
shots.narration: 冰浴足够时间，产物析得更完全。

shots.scene: 备好冰冷溶剂和抽滤装置
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bottle of ice cold solvent in an ice bath beside a clamped vacuum filtration setup with a clean dry filter flask. No text.
shots.narration: 备好冰冷溶剂，搭好抽滤装置。

shots.scene: 【实拍】冷溶剂润湿滤纸，倒入晶体
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: cold water wets the filter paper in a porcelain filter funnel under gentle suction, then the crystal slurry is swirled and poured in.
shots.narration: 冷溶剂润湿滤纸，晶体连母液倒入。

shots.scene: 【实拍】瓶里残留用冷溶剂冲下
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a little cold water rinses the remaining crystals from the flask into the funnel.
shots.narration: 瓶里剩下的，用冷溶剂冲下来。

shots.scene: 【实拍】少量冷溶剂淋洗晶体
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a small portion of ice cold water drizzled evenly over the crystal cake in the funnel.
shots.narration: 少量冷溶剂淋洗，洗掉母液杂质。

shots.scene: 母液浓缩可得第二批
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the filtrate concentrated and cooled again to give a smaller second crop of crystals. No text.
shots.narration: 母液浓缩再结晶，常能得第二批。

shots.scene: 继续抽几分钟
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: air being drawn through the crystal cake for a few minutes, liquid drops stopping. No text.
shots.narration: 继续抽几分钟，把晶体抽干。

shots.scene: 【实拍】刮到表面皿上摊开
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a spatula transfers the crystals from the filter paper onto a watch glass and spreads them thin.
shots.narration: 刮到表面皿上，摊开便于干燥。

shots.scene: 按性质选晾干、干燥器或烘箱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: options of air drying, a desiccator and a low temperature oven, chosen by the compound icon. No text.
shots.narration: 按性质选晾干、干燥器或烘箱。

shots.scene: 湿着易燃溶剂不进烘箱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: crystals wet with flammable solvent placed into an oven crossed out, an oven set below the melting point checked. No text.
shots.narration: 带易燃溶剂不进烘箱，温度低于熔点。

shots.scene: 称晶体算回收率
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the dried crystals weighed on a balance, a fraction of recovered mass over starting mass. No text.
shots.narration: 称一称：回收率等于回收除以原重。

shots.scene: 总不到百分之百
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a recovery bar below one hundred percent with removed impurity icons and a small loss icon. No text.
shots.narration: 去了杂质也有损失，总不到百分百。

shots.scene: 测熔点检验纯度
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: dried crystals loaded into a thin capillary beside a melting point apparatus. No text.
shots.narration: 纯不纯，可以测熔点来看。

shots.scene: 找不到单一溶剂就用两种
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two solvent bottles, one dissolving the sample at room temperature, one not dissolving it even when boiling, and a mixing icon showing they blend into one phase. No text.
shots.narration: 一种室温能溶，一种煮沸也不溶。

shots.scene: 两种溶剂要互溶不分层
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two solvents mixing into a single clear phase checked, two solvents forming layers crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 两种溶剂还要互溶，不能分层。

shots.scene: 热溶剂一溶解，滴溶剂二到持续浑浊
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the sample dissolved in a little hot first solvent, the second solvent added drop by drop until a lasting cloudiness appears. No text.
shots.narration: 先用溶剂一溶，再滴溶剂二到浑浊。

shots.scene: 再滴溶剂一刚好变清
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a few drops of hot first solvent added until the cloudiness just clears, then the flask set aside to cool. No text.
shots.narration: 再滴溶剂一刚好变清，静置冷却。

shots.scene: 冷的混合溶剂洗晶体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cold mixture of both solvents in a similar ratio used to rinse the crystals in the funnel. No text.
shots.narration: 用相近比例的冷混合溶剂洗晶体。

shots.scene: 固体不经熔化直接变气体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a solid crystal turning directly into vapor with an arrow skipping the liquid state. No text.
shots.narration: 固体不经熔化，直接变成气体。

shots.scene: 熔点以下有明显蒸气压才能升华
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a vapor pressure icon rising above a solid below its melting point, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 熔点以下蒸气压够大，才能升华。

shots.scene: 两个条件：不分解、杂质不升华
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two check icons, the compound not breaking apart when heated and cooled, the impurity staying behind as a residue. No text.
shots.narration: 条件：本身不分解，杂质不升华。

shots.scene: 常压与减压升华原理相同
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an atmospheric sublimation setup and a reduced pressure sublimation setup side by side with an equal sign. No text.
shots.narration: 常压减压升华，原理步骤相同。

shots.scene: 【实拍】粗样转进皿里摊薄
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a spatula spreads a crude off-white powder into a thin even layer across a glass dish.
shots.narration: 粗样转进皿里，摊平摊薄。

shots.scene: 【实拍】盖上皿盖，上面放冰水杯
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a glass lid placed on the dish, then a small beaker of ice water set on top of the lid, on a hot plate that is switched off.
shots.narration: 盖上皿盖，上面放杯冰水当冷面。

shots.scene: 也可用冷指和减压装置
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sublimation tube with a cold finger condenser inside, cooling water in low and out high, a vacuum line with a trap. No text.
shots.narration: 也可用冷指装置，先通冷却水。

shots.scene: 加热开到很低
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hot plate dial set very low, a patience clock icon. No text.
shots.narration: 加热开得很低，耐心等。

shots.scene: 过热样品就毁了
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a darkened charred sample in an overheated dish, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 加热过头，样品就毁了。

shots.scene: 冷盖上长出晶体，长成一层就关热
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: shiny crystals forming on the underside of the cold lid, then the hot plate switched off. No text.
shots.narration: 冷面长出一层晶体，就关加热。

shots.scene: 先稍冷却，轻轻滑开冰杯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a short cooling clock, then the ice beaker slid gently sideways off the lid. No text.
shots.narration: 稍冷一冷，再轻轻滑开冰水杯。

shots.scene: 小心皿盖粘在杯底，晶体掉落
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the lid stuck to the bottom of the ice beaker and lifting with it, crystals falling off, a caution icon. No text.
shots.narration: 小心皿盖粘杯底，晶体会掉。

shots.scene: 【实拍】揭盖，把晶体刮到表面皿
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the lid turned over gently and the crystals on its underside scraped with a spatula onto a clean watch glass.
shots.narration: 小心揭盖，晶体刮到表面皿上。

shots.scene: 和粗样对比，重复收下一批
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: clean crystals next to the crude sample, then the lid replaced with the ice beaker for another round, a repeat arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 比一比干净多了，再收下一批。

shots.section_title: 升华在通风柜，防烫不离人
shots.scene: 升华在通风柜内进行
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the sublimation dish and hot plate inside a fume hood with the sash lowered, vapor kept inside. No text.
shots.narration: 化合物会变成蒸气，在通风柜里做。
overlay: 升华在通风柜，防烫不离人

shots.section_title: 升华在通风柜，防烫不离人
shots.scene: 关了也烫，用夹子或隔热手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hot plate switched off but still glowing with heat waves, tongs and a heat resistant glove used to move the dish. No text.
shots.narration: 热板关了也烫，用夹子隔热手套。

shots.section_title: 升华在通风柜，防烫不离人
shots.scene: 加热不离人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student watching the hot plate, an empty bench with the hot plate on crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 升华时间长，加热不离人。

shots.scene: 母液、洗涤液进废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: mother liquor and washings poured into labeled organic or aqueous waste containers, a sink crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 母液洗涤液，按类倒进废液桶。

shots.scene: 滤纸、活性炭、残渣进固废
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: used filter paper with carbon and filter aid, and sublimation residue placed into a labeled solid chemical waste bin. No text.
shots.narration: 滤纸活性炭和残渣，进固体废物。

shots.scene: 选对溶剂，最少热溶剂，趁热滤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a solvent check icon, a few drops of hot solvent, a fluted filter. No text.
shots.narration: 选对溶剂，最少热溶剂，趁热过滤。

shots.scene: 慢冷、冰浴、冷溶剂洗、干燥
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a covered flask cooling slowly, an ice bath, a cold wash in a filter funnel and a watch glass of dry crystals. No text.
shots.narration: 慢慢冷却，冰浴，冷溶剂洗涤。

shots.scene: 无明火、通风柜、热瓶用夹子、升华低温
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flame crossed out, a fume hood, tongs on a hot flask and a low heat sublimation dish. No text.
shots.narration: 不用明火，进通风柜，升华低温。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在熔点仪旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a melting point apparatus holding a thin capillary tube, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：熔点测定。
